baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُجَٰدِلُونَ ... بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ links disputing to the non-arrival of السلطان.
baseline_models.mechanism: Twisted, adversarial speech tries to overpower visible signs, but the verse subjects that speech to an arrival test: decisive authority must come to the speakers rather than be generated by their own verbal force.

activation_trace.role: Twisted contention supplies the speech mechanism: repeated verbal engagement seeks mastery over an opponent.
The visible sign supplies the object already available for recognition rather than invention.
Overpowering proof supplies the missing warrant whose absence verbal dominance cannot repair.
Arrival supplies the admissibility condition: the warrant would have had to reach them.

changed_reading.before: They argue about God's signs without proof.
changed_reading.after: Their argument has force only as verbal contest; it fails because no decisive warrant has arrived from beyond that contest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ places an unattained magnitude inside the breasts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interior source magnifies an object until it appears great, then projects it as a destination. Disputation is therefore driven by an inward bid for greatness whose desired endpoint remains inaccessible.

activation_trace.role: The source from which actions issue locates the causal pressure of the dispute in the interior.
Magnifying something in the breast supplies the perceptual inflation that turns desire into a claim of greatness.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the social and vertical goal of the inflation.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the denied completion of the inward project.

changed_reading.before: Pride motivates the disputants, but they will not get what they want.
changed_reading.after: Their speech externalizes an inward act of self-magnification: it aims at a greatness configured as a destination, yet cannot complete the ascent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ redirects the addressee from the dispute to the One named ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Refuge transfers exposure from the opponents' verbal arena to divine protection. Hearing covers their uttered contest, while penetrating sight covers the interior magnitude that speech conceals.

activation_trace.role: Protective recourse supplies the move away from answering domination on its own terms.
Perception of voices supplies complete reception of the spoken dispute.
Penetrating insight supplies perception of the inward motive beyond audible claims.

changed_reading.before: Seek God's protection from hostile disputants because He knows what they do.
changed_reading.after: Refuge is a transfer to a protector whose hearing receives the public argument and whose sight penetrates its concealed interior cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah positively pairs Moses' signs with manifest overpowering proof, then states that even a messenger brings a sign only by divine permission. Against those controls, the focus disputants possess neither delivered proof nor authorization; their speech is self-issued authority.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering proof supplies the focus verse's explicitly absent warrant.
Arrival supplies the focus test that their claimed authority fails.
Visible signs supply the positive object paired with an actual warrant in Moses' mission.
Manifest overpowering proof supplies the positive counterpart to the focus disputants' missing authority.
The messenger's bringing of a sign confirms that valid evidence enters through a governed act of arrival.
The visible sign remains the delivered item rather than a product of the disputant's assertion.
Permission supplies the authorization gate even a messenger does not bypass.

structural_cues: 40:23 gives the positive pair of signs and manifest السلطان.
40:78 makes divine permission the condition for a messenger to bring a sign.
The focus negates both possession and arrival: no السلطان came to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive delivery at 40:23, an authorization gate at 40:78, and negated arrival at 40:56; I infer that the disputants compensate by self-authorizing their speech. A live alternative is the narrower claim that they merely lack evidence, without an authorization contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their case is evidentially weak because they have no proof.
changed_reading.after: Their case is procedurally inverted: genuine signs and warrants are delivered under permission, while their contest manufactures authority from its own force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact disputing formula appears at 40:35 with an arrogant, domineering heart; Pharaoh immediately orders a lofty structure so that he may reach the ropes or links of heaven and inspect Moses' God. The links terminate in ruin, narratively staging the focus verse's inward greatness as an engineered but failed ascent.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting greatness supplies the focus motive that seeks vertical realization.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the completion explicitly denied in the focus.
The repeated twisted contention identifies Pharaoh's surrounding episode with the focus disputing mechanism.
Greatness and self-exaltation explicitly attach the repeated formula to the arrogant heart.
Pharaoh's stated wish to reach an endpoint converts the focus's abstract non-attainment into a voiced project.
A rope or connecting link supplies the imagined means by which the upward project would attain its target.
The repeated rope or link extends the attempted connection specifically toward the heavens.
Loss and ruin supply the terminal state of the supposedly elevating scheme.

structural_cues: 40:35 repeats nearly the entire focus opening and adds the arrogant domineering heart.
40:36 follows immediately with Pharaoh's أَبْلُغُ and a commanded tower.
40:37 repeats the heavenly links and closes Pharaoh's scheme with تَبَاب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact formula, immediate sequence, repeated reach vocabulary, links, and ruin; I infer that Pharaoh's construction is an enacted instance of the focus's blocked kibr. A live alternative is that the tower illustrates deception generally and does not determine the pronoun in بِبَٰلِغِيهِ.

changed_reading.before: The disputants will not attain the status imagined by their pride.
changed_reading.after: Their non-attainment is staged as Pharaoh's architecture of self-magnification: argument becomes an attempted climb toward epistemic and sovereign height, but its connecting means end in ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, God knows what breasts conceal and judges decisively while hearing and seeing; Moses takes refuge from every arrogant denier; the believing man then hands his affair to God, who sees and protects him. The focus imperative compresses that sequence into a strategy: expose neither truth nor self to the opponent's dominance game, but hand the case to divine perception and protection.

activation_trace.role: Protective recourse anchors the focus command as an active change of protector and forum.
Complete reception of voices supplies divine access to the overt dispute.
Penetrating insight supplies divine access to the concealed motive and case.
The interior source of action is explicitly something God knows even when it conceals its contents.
Decisive judgment supplies the forensic function of the hearing and seeing formula.
Hearing voices links the focus epithet to the earlier scene of true judgment.
Penetrating sight completes the earlier adjudicative pair repeated in the focus.
Moses' recourse supplies the surah's explicit precedent for the focus imperative.
The self-exalting person names the same threat against which Moses seeks refuge.
Returning one's affair to another in reliance supplies the procedural handoff enacted by the believing man.
Divine penetrating sight names the capacity to which the believing man entrusts his affair.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the narrated result after entrustment.

structural_cues: 40:19–20 moves from concealed breasts to decisive judgment and the same hearing-seeing pair.
40:27 pairs refuge directly with a self-exalting opponent.
40:44–45 sequences entrustment, divine sight, and protection.
40:56 recombines refuge, interior kibr, hearing, and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent terms and the 40:44–45 sequence; I infer a functional arrow from entrustment and divine perception to protection, making refuge a handoff rather than mere retreat. A live alternative is that the epithets only reassure and the protection sequence is not a procedural model.

changed_reading.before: The addressee should withdraw from provocation and ask God for safety.
changed_reading.after: The addressee adopts the Moses-believer strategy: transfer the dispute and its hidden motive to the One who can judge, hear, see, and turn entrusted exposure into protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately following the focus installs created cosmic scale as what is actually greater than human creation. Soon afterward, self-exaltation against worship terminates in abasement. The unattained kibr is thus a false measurement of creaturely scale as well as a moral attitude.

activation_trace.role: Magnitude opposed to smallness supplies the focus disputants' implicit scale claim.
Actual greater magnitude supplies the immediate cosmic correction to human self-enlargement.
Creative origination supplies the measured comparison between heavens and earth and humanity.
Self-exaltation supplies the behavioral expression of the focus's inward kibr.
Abasement and smallness reverse the self-elevating posture and supply its terminal scale.

structural_cues: 40:57 immediately answers focus kibr with a comparative أَكْبَرُ.
40:60 places يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ and دَاخِرِينَ in one causal sentence.
The sequence moves from inward magnitude to cosmic comparison to social abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the repeated k-b-r root, a creation comparison, and an abasement outcome; I infer that 40:57 recalibrates the scale imagined in 40:56. A live alternative is that 40:57 only offers an independent resurrection proof.

changed_reading.before: They fail to gain the greatness they arrogantly seek.
changed_reading.after: Their very scale is false: cosmic creation exposes human smallness, and refusal to worship converts attempted elevation into abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later reaching is not rejected: created humans reach maturity and an appointed term, and provided carriers let them reach a need in their breasts. The focus therefore blocks the self-magnifying object of kibr, not reaching or inward desire as such; legitimate attainment is timed, provisioned, and carried rather than self-elevating.

activation_trace.role: The interior source anchors the focus's blocked aspiration.
Self-exalting greatness specifies which interior object fails.
Reaching an endpoint anchors the focus's explicit denial.
Creative origination supplies the dependent process within which later reaching occurs.
Reaching maturity and an appointed endpoint supplies legitimate, timed attainment.
Reaching an endpoint reappears positively in close construction with breasts.
Need and dependence replace kibr as the interior object that may rightly be attained.
The interior source recreates the focus pairing while changing its content from kibr to need.
A carrying vehicle supplies the external means that enables dependent attainment.

structural_cues: 40:67 repeats ب ل غ for created maturation and an appointed term.
40:80 repeats both ب ل غ and ص د ر but places حاجة, not كبر, in the interior.
40:79–80 supplies animals and ships as carrying means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated reach-breast construction and explicit carriers; I infer a contrast between unsupported self-magnification and dependent, provided attainment. A live alternative is that 40:80 is an independent utility statement whose lexical echo does not revise 40:56.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents inward aspiration as a futile attempt to reach.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns a specific unsupported object, kibr: needs in the breast can be reached when creaturely growth, timing, and carrying means are received rather than self-authored.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes a branch image rather than deriving a lexical definition. It remains anchored because the exact disputing phrase returns at 40:69 immediately before collars, linked chains, and dragging at 40:71. Downstream prose should present it only as a whole-surah material echo, not as the meaning of ج د ل or as a hidden causal claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tightly twisted branch of ج د ل in يُجَٰدِلُونَ can be carried as a material image without replacing the ordinary adversarial sense.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the exploratory material image latent in the focus dispute.
The repeated tight-twisting root reactivates the image immediately before bodily restraint.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the first bodily externalization of verbal entanglement.
Connected links supply the chain form that visually answers tight twisting.
Dragging and extending the bound body supplies the terminal motion of the material echo.

changed_reading.before: Disputation is verbal entanglement directed against the signs.
changed_reading.after: The whole-surah sequence lets verbal twisting echo forward as linked restraint: the recurring contest is followed by bodies caught in collars and chains and dragged.

strongest_changes: The exact 40:35 recurrence and Pharaoh's أَبْلُغُ project at 40:36–37 turn unattained kibr into a failed architecture of ascent.
Moses' refuge at 40:27 and the believing man's entrustment-protection sequence at 40:44–45 make فَٱسْتَعِذْ a protective handoff to divine adjudication.
The positive warrant controls at 40:23 and 40:78 recast the disputants' problem as self-authorized speech, not merely weak evidence.
The reach-breast pairing at 40:80 distinguishes futile self-magnification from legitimate need attained through provided means.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet produced unusually dense recombinations of the focus roots: the opening formula recurs, Pharaoh voices the denied reaching, refuge is enacted and answered by protection, true scale immediately corrects kibr, and later ب ل غ plus ص د ر supplies a positive countermodel.
remaining_uncertainties: The Pharaoh sequence strongly stages non-attainment but need not exhaust the antecedent or scope of بِبَٰلِغِيهِ.
The 40:80 countermodel may be a deliberate contrast or a strong lexical echo without direct local argument.
The twist-to-chains model should remain exploratory and material, not lexicalized.
